title: Add custom instance uniforms SSBO and compute shader pipeline support
body:
Add new SCOPE_CUSTOM_INSTANCE uniform scope and 'custom uniform' shader keyword for per-instance data read from a dedicated SSBO. This enables GPU-driven uniform updates via compute shaders instead of per-frame RenderingServer::instance_geometry_set_shader_parameter() calls.

Engine modifications:
- scene_forward_clustered_inc.glsl: Add custom_instance_uniforms SSBO (set=0, binding=21)
- scene_forward_clustered_inc.glsl: Add custom_uniforms_ofs to InstanceData struct
- shader_language.h: Add SCOPE_CUSTOM_INSTANCE to UniformScope enum
- shader_compiler.h: Add custom_global_buffer_array_variable and custom_instance_uniform_index_variable
- shader_compiler.cpp: Add SCOPE_CUSTOM_INSTANCE code generation branches
- shader_language.cpp: Add 'custom uniform' keyword parsing
- scene_shader_forward_clustered.cpp: Wire up custom uniform actions in init()
- render_forward_clustered.cpp: Populate custom_uniforms_ofs in _fill_instance_data()
- rendering_method.h: Add pre_render_compute() virtual hook
- renderer_scene_cull.cpp: Call pre_render_compute() in update()
- renderer_scene_cull.h: Add custom_shader_uniforms_offset field and setter
- renderer_scene_cull.cpp: Implement instance_geometry_set_custom_shader_uniforms_offset()
- rendering_server.h: Add virtual method declaration
- rendering_server.cpp: Bind new method to GDExtension API
